definitions: A means by which something is communicated or expressed.
A substance or an environment in which something exists or thrives.
A person thought to have the power to communicate with the spirits of the dead.
The middle point between two extremes; a compromise.
A particular grade of steak, cooked so that it is no longer red in the centre but still pink.
examples: Bacteria grew in the culture medium.
She consulted a medium about her future.
I'll have my steak medium, please.
